limitations_and_boundaries: The paper focuses on interventional Markov equivalence for DAGs under single-variable interventions; general interventions are not fully characterized.
GIES has exponential worst-case complexity, though empirical runtime suggests polynomial behavior.
The DREAM4 evaluation is limited to synthetic data with 10-gene networks; performance on larger or real-world networks is not assessed.
The theoretical results assume strictly positive densities and perfect interventions; violations may affect identifiability.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
